summary: API regression suite passed all 5 checks; browser verified public load, category filtering, checkout required-field validation, and visual desktop rendering.
action_items: Run a clean browser context to complete the authenticated admin edit/save and mobile menu checks.
Keep PayPal return/cancel URLs environment-configurable rather than hardcoded to a preview host.
Consider replacing synchronous requests calls inside async PayPal endpoints with an async HTTP client or thread offload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses blocking requests.post inside async create/capture handlers, which can stall the event loop under concurrent checkout traffic.
PayPal return_url and cancel_url are hardcoded to the preview deployment instead of environment configuration, risking incorrect production redirects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public offers, category filtering, checkout modal required validation, invalid PayPal offer safety, admin API login/protection, title, and desktop rendering were tested. Browser admin flow encountered an existing localStorage token and was not cleanly re-authenticated; offer edit/save, mobile menu, and valid PayPal redirect remain unverified.
rca of the issue: The browser admin assertion was caused by persisted overlay_admin_token state in the browser context: Control Room opened directly, so login inputs were unavailable. This is a test isolation limitation, not an observed application failure.
